versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Fload skill for mobile app analytics and growth management.

- Provides access to 18 Fload MCP tools for app data, reviews, analytics, ads, anomalies, and forecasting.
- Supports workflows for app health checks, review management, ad performance analysis, and business overviews.
- Tools available include growth score, growth audit, dashboard overview, anomaly detection, review management (including AI-generated replies), and ad campaign reporting.
- Integrates data across app stores, ad platforms, and analytics connectors.
- Includes actionable tips for tool selection and workflow guidance.
